about_short_description.short_description: Ruby Card provides a financial solution that unifies banking and commerce data for online businesses.

product.name: Comprehensive Banking
product.description: A financial platform integrating cards, expenses, accounting, and invoices into a single system for business banking needs.

product.name: Corporate Cards
product.description: Virtual Mastercard debit cards issued to businesses for managing and tracking corporate spending.

product.name: Automated Chargeback Resolution
product.description: A service that connects to commerce platforms to automatically detect and resolve payment chargebacks.

product.name: Vendor Reimbursements
product.description: A service that audits and recovers hidden or erroneous marketplace, shipping, and third-party logistics fees for businesses.

product.name: Centralized Financial Insights
product.description: A platform feature that consolidates sales, revenue, and financial data into a single view for business analysis and decision-making.

product.name: Embedded Accounting
product.description: A double-entry accounting system integrated with e-commerce connectors and financial reporting tools for ledger management.
